This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on Thursday, 13th November, 2026, has considered and approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, as reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee.
Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose the following:
Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
Statement of Assets and Liabilities.
Statement of Cash Flows.
Segment Reporting.
Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors.
The aforesaid results, along with the Limited Review Report, are also available on the Company''s website at www.nouveauglobal.com.
